content: Godaa aylley Musey hayqidaape guye, Goday Muse maaddiya Nawe na7aa Iyyasu, haysada yaagis.
“Ta aylley, Musey hayqis. Hessa gisho, neeranne ha asa ubbay dendidi, taani Isra7eele asaas immanaw de7iya biitta gelanaw, Yordaanose shaafa pinnite.
Taani Muses odidaysada, hinte tohoy yedhiyaso ubba hintew immas.

Hinte zaway dugeha Negebe mela biittafe dendidi, pudehan de7iya Libaanose zuma gakanaasa. Qassi doloha baggan de7iya Efraxiisa wogga shaafape dendidi, Hiteta biitta ubba ekidi wuloha baggan de7iya Medetrane abba gakanaasa.
Iyyasu, ne laytha ubban oonika neera eqetanaw danda7ena. Taani Musera gididaysada, neeraka gidana. Taani nena yeggike; aggike.
Aykoy baawa minna. Taani enta mayzatas immana gada caaqida biitta neeni ha asaa laatisana.
Aykoy baawa minna. Ta aylley Musey new immida higgiya ubbaa minthada naaga. Neeni biya bessa ubban new injetana mela iyape ushachi woyko haddirsi goopa.
Ha higge maxaafay ne doonape shaaketofo. Iyan xaafetidaba ubbaa minthada naaganaw gallasinne qamma iya qopa. Hessa ne oothiko, new ubbabay injetananne poletana.
Ne biya bessa ubban taani Goday ne Xoossay neera de7iya gisho, babofa; hirgofa; yaagada new odayis” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Iyyasuy deriya halaqata haysada yaagis;

“Asay dunkaanidi de7iya guta bidi, heedzu gallasa garsan, ‘Goday, hinte Xoossay, hintew immiya biitta laattanaw Yordaanose shaafa pinniya gisho, hintew shinqe giigisite’ yaagidi deriyas odite” yaagis.
Iyyasuy, Robeelanne Gaade kochata qassi Minaase kochatape bagga haysada yaagis;
“Goday, hinte Xoossay, hintena shempisana, ha biittaa hintew immana yaagidi, Godaa aylley Musey odidaysa qopite.

Hinte macheti, hinte naytinne hinte mehey Yordaanose Shaafape hafinthan Musey hintew immida biittan de7ishshona. Shin hinte olanchoti banta ola miishiya oykidi, hinte asaape sinthatidi, oletanaw Yordaanose shaafa pinnona.

Goday hintena shempisidaysada, entaka shempisana gakanawunne Goday hinte Xoossay entaw immiya biitta enti laattana gakanaw, enta maaddite; oletite. Yaatidi, simmi yidi, Yordaanose Shaafape hafinthan doloha baggan, Godaa aylley Musey immida hinte buzo biittan de7ite” yaagis.
Enti zaaridi Iyyasuko, “Ne nuna kiitida ubbaa nuuni oothana; ne kiittiyaso ubbaa baana.
Nuuni Muses ubbaban kiitetidaysada, newuka kiitetana. Goday, ne Xoossay Musera gididaysada, neeraka gido.
Neera eqeteynne ne kiita ixiya oonika de7iko, hayqo. Gidoshin neeni minna” yaagidosona.
